clauses.title: 1. Introduction
clauses.body: We take user privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy describes what information is collected, how it is used, and what measures are taken to protect it.

clauses.title: 2. Data We Collect
clauses.body: We do not profile or store personally identifiable information about users unless the service explicitly requires it to function (for example, a contact form or authentication).

clauses.title: 3. How We Use Data
clauses.body: When data is required, we only collect what is strictly necessary to provide the service, and it is used exclusively for that purpose, with no mass marketing or third-party sale.

clauses.title: 4. Data Minimization and No Profiling
clauses.body: No user profiling or advertising-driven segmentation is performed. Data collection is limited to the minimum necessary for the service to function.

clauses.title: 5. Cookies and Similar Technologies
clauses.body: The service may use cookies or similar technologies strictly necessary for its operation (for example, remembering language or interface preferences). No advertising tracking cookies are used.

clauses.title: 7. Information Security
clauses.body: Collected information is safeguarded with appropriate technical and organizational security measures, proportionate to the type of data and associated risk, aimed at preventing unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

clauses.title: 8. Data Retention
clauses.body: Data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, unless a legal obligation requires a longer retention period.

clauses.title: 9. User Rights
